verses.text: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus towards you.

Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvellous works. I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness, to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth. My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad. Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High, to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night.
Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation! Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits, who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful. Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord. Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

Speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands! Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings amongst the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted! Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!”
The LORD, your God, is amongst you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord. My spirit has rejoiced in God my Saviour, for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed. For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.”
One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice. He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live. Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labour, is the gift of God.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said amongst the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you. So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

Then he called them both privately, and said to them, “Bless God, and give him thanks, and magnify him, and give him thanks in the sight of all that live, for the things which he has done with you. It is good to bless God and exalt his name, showing forth with honour the works of God. Don’t be slack to give him thanks.”
Now bless the God of all, who everywhere does great things, who exalts our days from the womb, and deals with us according to his mercy.
I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God.
The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

messages.text: Today is a gift from God. Thank Him for it.
Joy is a fruit of the Holy Spirit. Let it overflow into kindness today.
Pray the Magnificat with Mary: My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord.
Count your blessings out loud. Gratitude makes joy grow.
Every good and perfect gift comes from above. Who can you thank today?
Rejoice in the Lord always. Again I say, rejoice.
Share your joy. Call someone and tell them something good that happened.
Thank God for the people in your life. Each one is a gift.
Happy days are a taste of heaven. Enjoy them and give God the glory.
Only one of the ten healed lepers came back to say thank you. Be that one.
The word Eucharist means thanksgiving. Bring your joy to Mass this week.
Joy is not the absence of trouble. It is the presence of God.
Let your gratitude become generosity. Bless someone else today.
Thank God for answered prayers, and for the ones He answered better than you asked.
Sing today. An old saying in the Church tells us that whoever sings prays twice.
Write down three things you are thankful for and keep the list.
Saint Francis praised God for Brother Sun and Sister Moon. Look around and praise Him for creation.
A grateful heart is a happy heart.
God delights in your joy. He is smiling with you.
Remember the hard times God carried you through, and thank Him for His faithfulness.
This is the day the Lord has made. Let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Joy is contagious. Let yours point others to God.
Thank God for your health, your breath and this very moment.
Praise Him for His love, which endures forever.
Even small joys are holy: a good meal, a laugh, a warm sun.
Pray the Glory Be with a full heart today.
Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
Thank Mary for her prayers. A mother loves to hear her children say thank you.
Let today's happiness become a memory you can return to on harder days.
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits.
Celebrate! God loves a feast. Jesus' first miracle was at a wedding.
Thank God for the gift of faith. It is the greatest treasure you have.
The shepherds returned glorifying and praising God for all they had seen. Praise Him for what you see today.
Joy shared is joy doubled. Who can you share your blessings with?
The saints were joyful people. Let your joy shine as a witness to God's goodness.
Thank God for the beauty around you: the hills, the rain, the people.
Offer your happiness to God as a prayer of praise.
Remember that God gave you this joy. Hold it gently and gratefully.
A cheerful heart is good medicine. Laugh freely today.
Thank God for His mercy, which is new every morning.
Let your joy become a prayer for someone who is struggling today.
Praise God from whom all blessings flow.
Give thanks in all circumstances, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
Your joy is a sign that God is good. Let the world see it.
Gratitude opens the door to more of God's grace.
Thank God for your family, your friends and your Church family.
Tell God thank you as simply as a child would. He loves it.
Taste and see that the Lord is good.
Let your thanksgiving spill over into service. Joy grows when it is given away.
End today with a thank you prayer. God has been good to you.
